roles.name: planner
roles.description: Inspect the repository and turn the goal into bounded, dependency-aware work packets.
roles.deliverable: A synthesized plan with scope, dependencies, risks, file boundaries, and verification commands.

roles.name: scout
roles.description: Luna-first routine discovery: investigate one question without changing repository files; escalate architectural uncertainty to the planner.
roles.deliverable: Evidence-backed findings with file references, reproduction steps, uncertainty, and no edits.

roles.name: test-writer
roles.description: Create a focused failing contract for one bounded behavior change.
roles.deliverable: Owned test changes, the RED command and result, and any contract ambiguity.

roles.name: maker
roles.description: Own one bounded RED-to-GREEN task, writing the focused failing contract unless a separate test writer is justified.
roles.deliverable: Changed files, expected RED failure, GREEN evidence, and known risks.

roles.name: checker
roles.description: Independently review a change for correctness, regressions, and missing tests without editing it.
roles.deliverable: Prioritized findings with file/line evidence, verification results, and pass or fail verdict.

roles.name: security-checker
roles.description: Independently review changed trust boundaries, authorization, secrets, egress, and isolation.
roles.deliverable: Threat-boundary findings, negative-test evidence, scan results, and pass or fail verdict.
